summary: Tested the subscription/paywall-hide change (SUBSCRIPTIONS_ENABLED=false). Backend (pytest, 4/4 passed): confirmed is_premium remains true for fresh and existing users, onboarding_done persists correctly, and the pre-existing /api/subscribe mock still works server-side (just unreachable from UI). Frontend (Playwright, mobile viewport 375x667, real backend, dev-login flow): (1) Fresh brand-new user taken through all 6 onboarding slides via 'Next'/'Continue' tap-through -> navigated straight to /deity, paywall/subscription screens never rendered at any point. (2) Same fresh-user flow via 'Skip' button -> also lands directly on /deity. (3) Settings screen (test@mtree.dev, premium) SUBSCRIPTION section shows the static 'Status: FREE ✦' card with 'All features are free for everyone right now — nothing to pay or manage.' text, no chevron/arrow icon, and tapping the card does nothing (stays on /settings, /subscription never shown). (4) Confirmed /app/frontend/app/paywall.tsx and subscription.tsx files still exist on disk (not deleted), just unreachable via nav. (5) Regression: Daily Streak Reminder toggle, Reminder Center, language/country rows all render on Settings; Home screen renders correctly with bottom tab bar (Home/Wall/Me) after navigating back from Settings.

ui_bugs.issue: FOUND AND FIXED: The shared Card component silently dropped the `testID` prop whenever no `onPress` was passed (the non-pressable branch returned `<View style={...}>{children}</View>` without spreading testID). This made `settings-subscription` and `settings-streak-reminder-card` (both non-pressable Cards) completely invisible to any DOM/automation query, even though they rendered correct visible text on screen. Fixed by conditionally applying testID to the plain View when onPress is absent. Purely a testability fix; visual/functional behavior unchanged.
ui_bugs.priority: LOW (was blocking automated verification only, not a user-facing bug)

action_items: No blocking issues. Both requested changes (onboarding.tsx -> /deity redirect, settings.tsx static FREE card) work exactly as specified and verified end-to-end.

Applied a small testability fix in src/components/ui.tsx (Card testID prop was dropped for non-pressable cards) so future test runs can target settings-subscription and settings-streak-reminder-card directly. Recommend main agent review this 1-line diff (see updated_files) - low risk, additive only.
Confirmed /paywall and /subscription route files still exist on disk as required (defense-in-depth check) but are unreachable through any button in the normal flow.
critical_code_review_comments: onboarding.tsx: both goNext() and skip() correctly call router.replace('/deity') with a clear inline comment explaining the change is reversible (flip back to /paywall once billing is ready). No dead paywall-related code left executing.

settings.tsx: SUBSCRIPTIONS_ENABLED flag cleanly gates the tappable vs static Card via ternary, well-commented, and the static branch card has no onPress at all (not just a disabled handler) so it's truly non-interactive as required.

Card component bug (now fixed) was a good catch: any future non-pressable Card with a testID would silently fail to be queryable - worth a quick grep for other Card usages without onPress that expect testID visibility.
updated_files: /app/frontend/src/components/ui.tsx (Card component: testID now applied to the non-pressable View branch, not just the TouchableOpacity branch)

success_rate.frontend: 100% - onboarding redirect and settings subscription-hide both verified working, no regressions

seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_-prefixed / freshuser_*@mtree.dev dev-login users during testing to exercise the onboarding flow fresh each time - safe to leave, no production data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Onboarding flow test pattern: dev-login via POST /api/auth/dev-login?email=...@mtree.dev, set localStorage key 'mtree_session_token' to JSON.stringify(session_token), then goto app root - AuthNavGuard routes fresh users (onboarding_done:false) straight to /onboarding automatically. Onboarding slide buttons (skip + continue) use TouchableOpacity onPressIn (Reanimated New-Arch workaround, same as FilledButton elsewhere) - Playwright must use mouse.move+down+wait+up on bounding box, plain .click() does nothing. IMPORTANT: the shared Card component (src/components/ui.tsx) only applies testID when onPress is provided - if you add a new non-pressable Card with a testID in future features, verify this fix (already applied) is still in place, otherwise the testID silently won't render in DOM.
rca_of_issue: Card testID bug: `const inner = <View style={[styles.card, style]}>{children}</View>` never referenced the `testID` param at all in the non-onPress return path - it was only ever spread onto the TouchableOpacity wrapper used in the onPress branch. Not a regression from this session's change (pre-existing latent bug), but it was invisible until this session added two new non-pressable Cards (settings-subscription static card, settings-streak-reminder-card) that needed testID visibility for verification. Fixed with a one-line conditional testID application.
